name: mcp-coda
description: Coda MCP server (MCP 2026-07-28): docs, pages, tables, rows, formulas, permissions, automation.

settings.name: CODA_API_TOKEN
settings.description: Coda API token (also accepts CODA_TOKEN or CODA_PAT)

settings.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
settings.description: Shared read-only switch across the mcp-* servers (true/false); either this or CODA_READ_ONLY locks the server read-only and nothing lifts it at runtime

settings.name: CODA_HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN
settings.description: Bearer token (min 16 chars) to authenticate HTTP transports on a non-loopback host
